subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v2 01/10] mountd: factor out the per-path export attribute computation

2026-09-11.patch_summary: This patch refactors the code in the mountd service to factor out the computation of per-path export attributes into a separate function, `export_attrs_build`. This change is made to allow the netlink downcall to use this computation as well. The patch does not introduce any functional changes and only modifies the internal implementation of the mountd service.
